scope: Research-backed capability guardrails for crypto-ingestion-source; repository config remains authoritative for enabled chains/providers.

dexscreener.notes: Profiles/boosts are supplementary discovery signals, not a strict newest-pools feed. Two documented rate-limit bands: 60/min and 300/min.

geckoterminal.notes: Native api.geckoterminal.com/api/v2 researched at 30 calls/min free; CoinGecko shared keyless path differs.

defillama.notes: Context/enrichment source, not real-time new-token discovery. Free limits are fair-use/endpoint-dependent rather than one safe hardcoded number.

etherscan_v2.notes: Unified V2 API. Base/OP/BNB/Avalanche general free API access was removed in Nov 2025; verified-contract source/ABI remains separately free.

routescan.notes: Research identifies a free 5 calls/s or 100k/day alternative, but key/auth details were not fully resolved in the supplied research.

bsctrace_meganode.notes: Recommended migration direction in research, but exact endpoint shape and rate limit are unresolved. Do not ship without current official verification.

honeypot_is.notes: No official numeric rate limit is published. Skill policy is conservative self-throttling/caching; that policy is not a provider-published limit.

goplus.notes: Research documents 30 calls/min but also notes an emerging CU-model discrepancy. Verify current limits before production sizing.

helius.notes: Free snapshot: 1M credits/month, 10 standard RPC RPS, 2 DAS/Enhanced RPS. TOKEN_MINT is not a completeness guarantee.
